name: Glamour

components.pose: He stands angled about 45 degrees to the camera in a heroic three-quarter pose, weight on the back leg, one shoulder forward, glancing toward the camera with a bold, confident look and a slight smirk, a light breeze moving his hair.
components.effects: A few small {{MAGIC}} sparks of static dance along his knuckles and the ends of his hair - understated, nothing busy.

notes: Daily-post glamour shot: signature armor, heroic three-quarter pose, element-matched background, light magic only.
